mostWorthwhile.text: Following filtration with recovery was most worthwhile: it showed why the kidneys take useful substances back rather than just filtering out waste.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the ureters and bladder was clear but fairly predictable after the filtration sequence.

surprise.text: I was surprised that glucose and other useful substances pass through the filter alongside waste.

arbitrary.text: None felt arbitrary; the pictures and goals gave each connection a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would continue to see how another body system connects to the model, though the straightforward assembly steps were less engaging than the filter-and-recovery idea.
